learningObjectives: Identify major ascending arousal and thalamocortical systems.
Explain why motor output may underestimate awareness.
Recognise clinical causes of altered consciousness.

anatomy.label: Ascending brainstem systems
anatomy.detail: Reticular and monoaminergic nuclei broadcast state-setting signals.
anatomy.clinical: Damage can cause profound drowsiness or coma.

anatomy.label: Hypothalamus
anatomy.detail: Orexin and histamine systems stabilise wakefulness.
anatomy.clinical: Orexin loss is central to narcolepsy type 1.

anatomy.label: Thalamus
anatomy.detail: Intralaminar and relay nuclei support widespread cortical activation.
anatomy.clinical: Bilateral injury may severely impair responsiveness.

anatomy.label: Association cortex
anatomy.detail: Posterior and frontoparietal systems integrate perception and goals.
anatomy.clinical: Focal dysfunction can selectively disturb awareness.

anatomy.label: Global network integration
anatomy.detail: Effective connectivity changes with state and task.
anatomy.clinical: Disconnection may preserve islands of processing without reliable report.

interaction.title: Explore Consciousness & Arousal
interaction.instruction: Select a component, then run the sequence.

stages.label: Activate
stages.text: Brainstem and hypothalamic systems raise cortical readiness.

stages.label: Gate
stages.text: Thalamic circuits regulate access and synchrony.

stages.label: Integrate
stages.text: Distributed cortex combines sensory, memory and internal-state information.

stages.label: Respond
stages.text: Language and motor systems translate awareness into observable behaviour.

quizBank.question: Consciousness is best separated into:
quizBank.explanation: Arousal and awareness can dissociate clinically.

quizBank.question: The ascending arousal system is centred mainly in:
Why can awareness be underestimated?
options: Motor or language output may be impaired
quizBank.explanation: A person may be aware but unable to communicate reliably.

quizBank.question: Bilateral thalamic injury may cause:
options: Severe impairment of arousal and awareness
quizBank.explanation: The thalamus contributes to widespread cortical activation and integration.

quizBank.question: The most accurate model is:
options: Consciousness is a distributed systems property
One cortical spot creates all consciousness
quizBank.explanation: No single region alone explains conscious state and content.

reviewPrompts: The ascending arousal system is centred mainly in:
Never treat “awake” and “aware” as synonyms. Separate arousal, awareness, attention, communication and motor output.
